requirements.general: Entry Requirements Applicants must meet one of the following criteria: SPM/O-Level or equivalent: Minimum 3 Credits and a Pass in English. STPM or equivalent: Minimum Grade C (GP 2.00) in any subject and a Pass in SPM English. STAM: Minimum Maqbul (Pass) and a Pass in SPM English. UEC: Minimum 3 Grade B’s and a Pass in English. SKM (Level 3, MQF): In a related field. Certificate (Level 3, MQF): Minimum CGPA 2.00 in a related field. MQA APEL.A Certificate: For admission into Diploma programs. Note Upon completing the Diploma program, students who wish to pursue a Bachelor’s degree at MMU must meet the specific entry requirements for their chosen program
